owner_and_capability: Request Review read projection (request-review-view): the shared staff list of parent requests with origin, type, child, requested change and decision, plus the pending-count badge, over consumer-owned queue ports
atomic_cutover: One read-only projection serves GET /students/change-requests (open and history) and /students/change-requests/pending-count. api/base.go composes it over the retained review queues; api/students switches both routes in the same deploy and the four-service fan-out handler, its history mappers and the conflict scan are deleted from the HTTP package. The per-type wire shapes move into the projection's public package so the decide, preview and detail routes keep answering with the same shapes. No table changes owner; the projection persists nothing.
tests: Retained api/students handler tests (in-package fakes) and router tests over real keyset SQL run unchanged against the projection and pin JSON output, cursor contract, filters, permission narrowing and the badge; pure projection tests cover ordering, tie-break, paging, urgency phases, filters, empty pages, cursor progress over filtered rows, past consequences, conflict grouping, decorations and error passthrough; adapter tests pin the owner-rule facts per row, the filter/cursor translation, the badge counts and one owner-queue failure surfacing through the existing error contract; a two-tenant RLS proof over all four request tables runs the real retained queues under the least-privilege role with a query budget.

runtime_evidence.source: docs/runtime-checkpoints/request-review-2705.md with the baseline and candidate logs beside it; harness backend/api/students/change_request_review_runtime_test.go
runtime_evidence.workload: Local PostgreSQL 17.11, Go 1.27.0, package test database; baseline fixed at 939126a901 in a detached worktree; open list, history and pending-count over 0, 8 and 32 children with one pending request per queue and three decided requests each; five warmups and 30 samples per request, concurrency 1, both runs alone on the machine.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No new SLO. Statement parity with the pre-cutover reader per scenario; local same-workload comparison, not staging/production parity. New budget modules.requestreview.open_page (max 101) for the fixture-sized open page.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Identical on both sides: open 14/320/728, history 10/19/19, pending-count 8/156/564 statements for 0/8/32 children. Growth with the child count is the retained owner queues' per-request hydration, unchanged by the cutover.
runtime_evidence.errors: Zero unexpected errors, zero write rows, zero pool waits, zero deadlocks and no sampled lock waiters in either run. No projection cache.
runtime_evidence.failure: One owner-queue failure surfaces unchanged (errors.Is and 500 text) through the shared parent-request error rules; a missing queue or access port fails composition with ErrIncompleteSources; malformed queries answer 400 with the unchanged invalid-query error.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Projection persists nothing; every measured write_rows_affected was zero. Revert api/base.go and the api/students wiring to restore the retained fan-out handler without data migration.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Production students router with signed JWT, permission gates and tenant transaction serves all three routes for the admin reviewer; the absence-only reviewer keeps seeing only the excused queue (router test).

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert the consumer wiring (api/base.go composition, api/students handlers) as a whole while the retained queues remain intact; the read-only projection owns no authoritative state. The adapter's compatibility permissions convert to exact debt once the packages exist at a base SHA; the inbound-students adapter import goes when the decide routes move to their owners. No deployment or staging/production requests.
exit_criterion: Both staff consumers read the one projection with output parity, tenant safety and no direct cross-owner reads in api/students; no ratchet key added or removed (1647 legacy violations before and after), composition surface 796 unchanged, ownership and policy epoch 5 preserved.
